summary: feat(auth,settings): support service=monitor for Firefox Monitor
description:
Because:

- Monitor is integrating into Firefox and needs its own browser service.
- Monitor's silent token exchange must be gated on accountAuthorizations.

This commit:

- Adds monitor to OAuthNativeServices and treats it as a non-Sync service.
- Sends monitor in the web channel services and names it on sign-in.
- Maps monitor to apps/monitor in exchange and authorization serviceScopes.
- Allows Firefox Desktop and Monitor web (stage, prod) to write Monitor rows.
- Adds unit, exchange integration and Monitor desktop sign-in tests.

Fixes FXA-14723
Fixes FXA-14746
